shortDescription: Create a new log inspection rule.

options.name: alert_enabled
options.description: Controls whether to raise an alert when a LogInspectionRule logs an event. Use true to raise an alert.

options.name: alert_minimum_severity
options.description: Severity level that will trigger an alert. Ignored unless ruleXML contains multiple rules with different severities, and so you must indicate which severity level to use.

options.name: can_be_assigned_alone
options.description: Indicates whether this LogInspectionRule can be allocated without allocating any additional LogInspectionRules. Ignored if the rule is user-defined, which uses dependency instead.

options.name: dependency
options.description: Indicates if a dependant rule or dependency group is set or not. If set, the LogInspectionRule will only log an event if the dependency is triggered. Available for user-defined rules.

options.name: dependency_group
options.description: If dependency is configured, the dependancy groups that this rule is dependant on.

options.name: dependency_rule_id
options.description: If dependency is configured, the ID of the rule that this rule is dependant on. Ignored if the rule is from Trend Micro, which uses dependsOnRuleIDs instead.

options.name: depends_onrule_id
options.description: IDs of LogInspectionRules, separated by commas, that are required by this rule. Ignored if the rule is user-defined which uses dependency_rule_id or dependency_group instead.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the LogInspectionRule that appears in search results, and on the General tab in the Deep Security Manager user interface.

options.name: frequency
options.description: Number of times the dependant rule has to match within a specific time frame before the rule is triggered.

options.name: groups
options.description: Groups that the LogInspectionRule is assigned to, separated by commas. Useful when dependency is used as it's possible to create a LogInspectionRule that fires when another LogInspectionRule belonging to a specific group fires.

options.name: identifier
options.description: Indentifier of the LogInspectionRule used in the Deep Security Manager user interface.

options.name: last_updated
options.description: Update timestamp of the LogInspectionRule, measured in milliseconds since epoch.

options.name: level
options.description: Log level of the LogInspectionRule indicates severity of attack. Level 0 is the least severe and will not log an event. Level 15 is the most severe.

options.name: log_files
options.description: Log file objects

options.name: minimum_agent_version
options.description: Minimum Deep Security Agent version required by the LogInspectionRule.

options.name: minimum_manager_version
options.description: Minimumn Deep Security Manager version required by the LogInspectionRule.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the LogInspectionRule.

options.name: original_issue
options.description: Creation timestamp of the LogInspectionRule, measured in milliseconds since epoch.

options.name: pattern
options.description: Regular expression pattern the LogInspectionRule will look for in the logs. The rule will be triggered on a match. Open Source HIDS SEcurity (OSSEC) regular expression syntax is supported, see http://www.ossec.net/docs/syntax/regex.html.

options.name: pattern_type
options.description: Pattern the LogInspectionRule will look for in the logs. The string matching pattern is faster than the regex pattern.

options.name: recommendations_mode
options.description: Indicates whether recommendation scans consider the LogInspectionRule. Can be set to enabled or ignored. Custom rules cannot be recommended.

options.name: rule_description
options.description: Description of the LogInspectionRule that appears on events and the Content tab in the Deep Security Manager user interface. Alternatively, you can configure this by inserting a description in 'rule_xml'.

options.name: rule_id
options.description: ID of the LogInspectionRule sent to the Deep Security Agent. The values 100000 - 109999 are reserved for user-definded rules.

options.name: rule_xml
options.description: LogInspectionRule in an XML format. For information on the XML format, see http://ossec-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/syntax/head_rules.html

options.name: sort_order
options.description: Order in which LogInspectionRules are sent to the Deep Security Agent. Log inspeciton rules are sent in ascending order. Valid values are between 10000 and 20000.

options.name: state
options.description: The state the configuration should be left in

options.name: template
options.description: Template used to create this rule.

options.name: time_frame
options.description: Time period for the frequency of LogInspectionRule triggers that will generate an event, in seconds.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the LogInspectionRule. The value 'Defined' is used for LogInspectionRules provided by Trend Micro.
